name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
provider: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

rules.quote: All girl students who studied from Classes 6 to 12 in Government schools will be paid Rs.1,000/- per month directly into their bank account

rules.value: Studied classes 6-12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools
rules.quote: paid on a monthly basis to all eligible girl students who have studied from 6th 12th Std. in Government schools.
till the uninterrupted completion of their undergraduate degree, diploma and ITI courses

rules.value: Only first course of higher education; recognised institution; other scholarships allowed concurrently
rules.quote: only first course of higher education will be considered as an eligible factor

rules.value: Can be combined with other scholarships
rules.quote: The girl students availing other scholarships are also eligible to enroll in this scheme.

amount.text: Rs 1,000 per month via DBT till completion of first higher-education course
amount.quote: Cash incentive of Rs.1000/month per beneficiary as DBT will be sanctioned till the competition of their first higher education.

deadline.text: Rolling; apply on the Penkalvi portal
deadline.quote: This scheme activity is implemented through online portal 'Penkalvi' wherein the girl students themselves can apply for the scheme directly.
